name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Collapsible stacked sections. Native <details>/<summary> + new HTML name attribute for zero-JS exclusive accordion. APG keyboard nav in site.js.

files.content:
defmodule ShadcnHtmx.Components.Accordion do @moduledoc """ Accordion — shadcn-htmx, htmx v4 + Tailwind v4 for Phoenix. Native `
` + ``. Single-expand mode (`type="single"`) uses the new HTML `name` attribute which makes the group exclusive with zero JS. Multi-expand mode just omits the name. Keyboard nav (arrows, Home/End) lives in public/site.js. ## Examples <.accordion id="faq" type="single"> <.accordion_item value="q1" open> <.accordion_trigger>What's htmx? <.accordion_content>Hypermedia-driven HTML extensions. """ use Phoenix.Component attr :id, :string, required: true attr :type, :string, default: "multiple", values: ~w(single multiple) attr :class, :string, default: nil slot :inner_block, required: true def accordion(assigns) do ~H"""
{render_slot(@inner_block)}
""" end attr :value, :string, required: true attr :open, :boolean, default: false attr :disabled, :boolean, default: false attr :class, :string, default: nil slot :inner_block, required: true def accordion_item(assigns) do ~H"""
{render_slot(@inner_block)}
""" end attr :class, :string, default: nil slot :inner_block, required: true def accordion_trigger(assigns) do ~H""" &_[data-slot=accordion-chevron]]:rotate-180", @class ]} > {render_slot(@inner_block)} """ end attr :class, :string, default: nil slot :inner_block, required: true def accordion_content(assigns) do ~H"""
{render_slot(@inner_block)}
""" end end

What's htmx?
Hypermedia-driven HTML extensions. AJAX, WebSockets, server-sent events with attributes.
Why pair it with Tailwind v4?
Utility-first CSS keeps the markup self-explanatory and the bundle small.
